info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Payment Reverse-spec
info.description: The Payment Reversal API allows financial institutions to process payment reversals for specific loans. By targeting a loan and a corresponding payment through their unique identifiers, users can initiate a reversal transaction. This is particularly useful in scenarios involving erroneous payments or customer disputes, enabling swift resolution. Typical consumers of this API include loan servicing teams and financial application developers who need to maintain accurate payment records and enhance customer service workflows.

post.summary: Reverse a specific payment for a loan.
post.description: This operation allows users to reverse a particular payment associated with a specific loan. It is essential for correcting payment errors or processing refunds. Ensure that the loan and payment identifiers are valid and that the payment is eligible for reversal.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to reverse a specified payment for a loan. It should include the necessary details for processing the reversal.
